_about: Hand-curated part of the board (the operator writes it). tools/board/build.mjs merges it with ROADMAP.md, each worktree's context/NOW.md and the live /status into docs/board/board-data.js. Keys: id = worktree folder name (and the artifact database id); roadmap_row = the exact start of the Area column in the ROADMAP.md areas table; image = path relative to docs/board/; purpose = what this area is for, in plain words, for someone who forgot.

areas.name: Ground and pearls
areas.purpose: What the player picks up from the ground, crafts, drops and loses on death, and the pearls that circulate as money. The persistent world: the server owns resources and crafting.

areas.name: Agents and companions
areas.purpose: Non-player characters with a mind of their own: the agent market, the durable companions that pair with you, and the safe presence of their mind in the world.

areas.name: Naval refuge and A0 region
areas.purpose: The raft as home: sailing, pilotage, anchoring in a refuge, and the first region of the world (A0) with Puerto Sol as its physical anchor.

areas.name: Progression and inventory
areas.purpose: How the character grows and what it carries: logging, load, backpacks, food and grog, artisan recipes and the teaching of trades.

areas.name: GM editor
areas.purpose: The game master's table: sculpt and paint terrain, place and publish resources, templates and scatter, and the coming Skill Studio for authoring skills.

areas.name: Character slots
areas.purpose: Three characters per account: the account owner split from the profile, and a presence lock so one account cannot enter twice.

areas.name: Bucanero
areas.purpose: The game's own playable fighter: the model, the hit reaction and the recoil. Balance and real-machine FPS are still to be accepted.

areas.name: Niagara library
areas.purpose: A catalogue of the Niagara particle effects (fire, smoke, sparks) censused from the Unreal sources: components and views to choose what to port into the game.

areas.name: Niagara native
areas.purpose: The lab that extracts one Niagara effect into native sprite sheets for the web engine, with measured fidelity (material, DepthFade, Filmic) and a lossless WebP atlas.

areas.name: Items art
areas.purpose: The 3D models of the world's objects (torch, logs, crates) as author GLBs with WebP derivatives, ready to be picked up in the game.

areas.name: Asset protocol
areas.purpose: The rules for naming, placing and registering every art asset, the generated ARTE-Y-MODELOS index, and the ratchet that stops the mess from growing back.

areas.name: I18N
areas.purpose: The game's texts in Spanish and English: the language selector and the promotion of pending keys to both languages.

areas.name: Web3 W0x
areas.purpose: An on-chain asset registry (Polygon Amoy) and the equipment rules tied to it. Nothing is live; it is a direction for the modular workshop.

areas.name: A0 to A8 region
areas.purpose: The plan for the initial world: regions A0 to A8, of which only the A0 survey exists. No code yet; it waits for the GM editor (GM06a).

areas.name: inv02 baseline
areas.purpose: An old snapshot of the code kept as the baseline for comparing test failures. Nobody works here; it is only compared against.

areas.name: Main desk
areas.purpose: The main checkout on loving-lovelace: a shared desk hundreds of commits behind. Never commit from it; the work lives in the worktrees.
